goal:
T58 — left feature rail (v3.8 §2.1; owner's layout: feature tabs at the far left, main content to the right).
Web only.
1. apps/web/components/FeatureRail.tsx (client component): a <nav aria-label=...> rail on the far left with an ITEMS
   array whose path strings are exactly, in this order: "/" (Mission Control, key mission-control), "/arena" (arena),
   "/replay" (replay), "/evidence" (evidence), "/performance" (performance), "/lab" (improvement-lab). Links are
   `${prefix}${path}` for the current locale prefix (as layout.tsx does today). The current page (usePathname) gets
   aria-current="page" and a highlighted style.
   Below them, a "More" disclosure (<details> or a button with aria-expanded) with "/evolution" (autopilot),
   "/leaderboard" (leaderboard), "/verify" — listed AFTER "/lab" in the file. Do not link pages that do not exist.
2. Responsive: on md+ the rail is a fixed-width column (icons + labels; may collapse to icons); below md it is hidden
   (class "hidden md:flex" or similar) and a compact top bar with a menu button opens it as a drawer. Content must not
   be squeezed by the rail on mobile.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/layout.tsx: replace the current horizontal nav links with <FeatureRail/> and lay out
   rail | main. Keep the language switcher and everything else the layout renders today.
4. i18n navigation namespace (en + ko): add "more" (and "verify" if you label it); reuse existing keys otherwise.
Keep tsc green and do not change page contents. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t58.py.
